rules.public_summary: Unauthorized access to private content or circumvention of access controls is prohibited.
required_evidence: Evidence that the content or access path was private or unauthorized
Request, configuration, or execution records showing attempted access or circumvention

rules.public_summary: Using Scoutpost for stalking, harassment, or doxxing is prohibited.
required_evidence: Records identifying the monitored target and the conduct under review
Corroborated context showing a stalking, harassment, or doxxing purpose or pattern

rules.public_summary: Coercive or discriminatory surveillance, including coercive employee monitoring, is prohibited.
required_evidence: Records identifying the monitored people, group, or employees
Corroborated context showing coercive or discriminatory surveillance

rules.public_summary: Prompt injection attempts to override Scoutpost instructions are prohibited.
required_evidence: Account-authored content or account configuration containing the suspected injection
Execution or request records tying the attempted injection to the account; monitored-source text is not attribution evidence

rules.public_summary: Rate-limit abuse of Scoutpost or source services is prohibited.
required_evidence: Timestamped request or execution records showing the request pattern
The applicable published rate limit or evidence of deliberate evasion

rules.public_summary: Using Scoutpost to generate or amplify misinformation is prohibited.
required_evidence: Account activity that generated, distributed, or amplified the claim
Corroborated source evidence establishing that the claim is materially false or misleading
